final_message:
The `wrap` function has been fixed. The issue was that the original condition `len(cur) + extra > width - 1` incorrectly split text when it exactly fit within the width. For example, with `"aaa bbb ccc"` and width 7, "aaa" + space + "bbb" equals exactly 7 characters, but the old logic still split them because of how the calculation was done.

The fix changes the condition to only split when adding a word would actually exceed the width (`len(cur) + 1 + len(w) > width`), which correctly handles edge cases like exact width fitting.
